metadata.description: Tc-99m SPECT point-source physics constants reviewed and frozen for the non-production SPECT calculation stack. Dataset approval does not enable production SPECT.
metadata.approval_basis: SPECT Step 20 source verification and project physics freeze; non-production use only.

records.half_life_provenance: Tc-99m half-life 6.0067 h; evaluated decay-data value consistent with NNDC-derived radionuclide tables and BIPM/ANSTO Tc-99m standardisation data.
records.dose_rate_provenance: Oumano et al., J Appl Clin Med Phys. 2025;26:e70084, DOI 10.1002/acm2.70084, Table 4 (citing Smith & Stabin 2012): Tc-99m gamma constant 0.795 R/mCi-h at 1 cm and f-factor 0.959 cGy/R. Derived at 1 m per MBq: 0.795*0.959 cGy/(mCi h) / 10000 * 10000 uGy/cGy / 37 MBq/mCi = 0.0206055 uGy/(MBq h), rounded to 0.0206 uSv/(MBq h) for photons (wR=1). This is an unattenuated point-source constant; no patient self-attenuation factor is embedded.
